name: loss-mitigation-closing
description: Finalize a permanent modification — trial outcome, mod-document QC checklist, and the 14-day county-recording SLA — and route a Cleared to Record / In QC / Recording / Denied / SLA Breach decision for human sign-off.

name: loss-mitigation-eligibility
description: Evaluate a delinquent loan against the GSE (Fannie/Freddie) retention waterfall — delinquency, hardship, affordability, exclusions — and route a Forbearance / Payment Deferral / Flex Modification (Trial) / Refer / Decline workout for human sign-off.

name: loss-mitigation-intake
description: Validate a borrower's loss-mitigation package (MAA + hardship/income documents) against investor matrices, compute completeness, and draft a borrower follow-up for missing items for human approval.

name: loss-mitigation-trial
description: Monitor a borrower's 3-month modification trial — payments made vs missed against the schedule and the 15-day grace — and route an On Track / At Risk / Completed / Broken outcome for human sign-off.

name: loss-mitigation-trial-underwriting
description: Underwrite the Flex Modification trial — recompute the modified P&I, payment-reduction % and post-mod DTI from the eligibility decision, verify the income/hardship package, check the NPV and investor delegation, generate the 3-month Trial Plan schedule, and route Trial Plan Ready / In Underwriting / Hold / Declined for human sign-off before the Trial Plan offer is sent to the borrower.
